title: Admin route renders its body for anonymous callers
description: GET /admin returns the administrative page with user and refund counts without any identity.
root_cause: The admin route has no server-side authentication check; the home page hides it only behind a link.
intended_behavior: Only an authenticated administrator receives the admin page.

conditions.description: the caller sends no cookie or token

reproduction.observed_result:
status 200 with the body

Admin

42 users, 7 refunds pending

remediation.strategy: Enforce the administrator role on the server before rendering /admin, and redirect anonymous callers.

changes.change: return 403 unless the session role is admin

impact.reason: the page discloses aggregate data, not per-user records

confidence.reason: the anonymous capture returns the admin body

title: Session cookie carries no Secure, HttpOnly, or SameSite attribute
description: The site issues sid with Path=/ only. The demo has no TLS and no script injection of its own, so the reader of this cookie is not established here.
claimed_root_cause: The cookie is written without transport, script, or cross-site scoping.
blockers: the demo serves plain HTTP, so Secure cannot be observed in effect
no script-execution primitive was captured on this site

validation_plan.next_probe: serve the same page over HTTPS and re-capture Set-Cookie to see whether Secure appears
validation_plan.owner_check: confirm whether production sets Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite at the edge or in the application

title: Search query is reflected into the HTML body without encoding
description: The value of q is concatenated into the results paragraph, so markup sent by a visitor is returned as markup.
root_cause: The results template interpolates the raw query string into HTML instead of encoding it.
intended_behavior: A query value is encoded for the context it is rendered into, so it appears as text, not markup.

conditions.description: a victim follows a crafted search link

steps: read the returned body around Results for
reproduction.observed_result:
the response contains

Results for probe

, so the marker is live markup

remediation.strategy: Encode the query value for HTML text at render time (escape <, >, &, " and ') and add the site's CSP as defence in depth.

likelihood.reason: the link is a normal GET a victim can be sent

impact.reason: script execution in the visitor's origin, no identity involved on this site

confidence.reason: two captures show the exact unescaped marker in the body
